notes.title: Verticality Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=j23JMfpR91c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Patch Notes 0.7[/h1]
[h3]Major Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated graphic for grappling rope.
[*] Implemented log for gravity flip and crushing events.
[*] Added four single player levels.
[*] Adjusted game to be playable offline and added single player menu.
[*] Implemented existing events to new game logger.
[*] Added WhirliVortex and Bottom Left Game Logger.
[*] Updated game over UI appearance and added limited health barrier.
[*] Added Gravity Flipping, swinging, and player crushing.
[*] Added achievement for crushing a player.
[*] Introduced TrailBlazer Ball.
[/list]
[h3]Minor Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted gravity wells to cap at just enough to be dangerous.
[*] Added controls to pause menu.
[*] Polished menus and In-Game UI.
[*] Showed version at main menu.
[*] Updated Force and Anti powerup graphics.
[*] Made leaderboard toggleable with tab.
[*] Added Display For Players Gaining Powerups.
[*] Updated flame collisions for more realism.
[*] Added various visual effects to play.
[*] Added delay before modern art appearing.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ensured elimination sounds appear on clients.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could fall through the ground.
[*] Fixed inconsistency in victory condition.
[*] Fixed a bug where entire ghost ball was visible.
[*] Investigated and resolved issue with flame ball flying through barriers.
[*] Ensured flame spout appears properly on each ball.
[*] Fixed a bug where the countdown didn't appear on clients.
[*] Checked and fixed Cue Scaling.
[*] Fixed cue after elimination.
[/list]

notes.title: DevLog 1 - Current Modes and Powerups
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the first devlog of my game, Pool Ball Battle Royale! In this series, I'll be discussing the development process, features, and progress of the game. For this first episode, let's dive into the current state of the game and its core mechanics.
[previewyoutube=XnrfQP-U6bs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: QOL Update 0.6.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added Linux Support
[*] Added Pool Cue in place of Charge Bar
[*] Name tags are now hidden when a player is out of range for ghost ball
[*] Changed background song to enhance game atmosphere
[*] Introduced table cycling for player matches
[*] Inputs are now more responsive, and balls can be moved with Space or Mouse Click
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with Big Table Mode not functioning properly with the new power-up ball spawn process
[*] Resolved balls sometimes appearing when toggled off
[/list]

notes.title: Flame Ball, Ghost Ball, Achievements!
notes.notes:
[h2]Major Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Add Ghost Ball and Flamethrower Ball
[*] Implement powerup ball pool system, replacing scene-linked balls
[*] Introduce public match mode with a mode selector
[*] Create mid-game join feature
[*] Implement Steam achievements based on statistics and certain objectives
[*] Add spectator mode and improved in-game player statistics display
[/list]

[h2]Minor Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Upgrade the appearance of power up balls
[*] Separate UI elements into tabs and display current streak in-game
[*] Switch to more performant build process
[*] Introduce host input delay and remove login screen
[*] Customize looker to match player color
[*] Add ball trails, updated graphics for power up balls, and edge smoothing
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fix bug where same ball color would appear for multiple players
[*] Ensure proper handling of players leaving mid-game in Plague mode
[*] Disallow incompatible game versions
[/list]
